status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Sampson (knee) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.
status.longComment: It's unclear exactly how much time Sampson will miss. He is expected back this season, per Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer, but his placement on IR means he will miss at least the next four games. Jaleel McLaughlin was brought up from the practice squad, and both he and Raheim Sanders -- who played 18 snaps on offense and got four touches Sunday after Sampson's exit -- will work behind starter Quinshon Judkins.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Campbell (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus Tampa Bay, Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site reports.
status.longComment: Campbell didn't practice Thursday but logged a limited session Friday, so there's hope concerning his availability against the Buccaneers. If the ankle injury prevents Campbell from getting on the field, Noah Igbinoghene or Mekhi Blackmon may fill in and line up opposite Denzel Ward.
